scope: Runtime scene selection for the promoted first-five-noncompdata-ui ISO. scene_dispositions.reason: The 275-entry aggregate has a disjoint 22-group static scene map. All eighteen purely player-facing groups covering 253 entries and nine statically identifiable player-facing entries from two mixed groups now have promoted writers and exact runtime routes. The remaining thirteen corrupt, NULL diagnostic, raw control, standalone format and ambiguous Set fragments remain deliberately excluded.
